column3: A project is drawn with one of the 24 glyphs from `I3`, not with a Lucide icon; the tile corner carries its state
column4: `I3` is explicit that the mark is geometry on a 24 grid, picked from the project’ words, and that status lives on the tile, never inside the glyph; Lucide icons made every project read as a generic symbol and dropped the corner state entirely
column5: the frame’ 24 path sets copied verbatim into `lib/project-glyphs.ts`; `projectGlyph` picks the first word match then hashes the slug; `ProjectGlyph` draws at 24 grid with a 1.5 stroke and one solid part, and `Corner` breathes white for working, pulses orange for waiting and sits red for failed
column6: agent-browser at 1440 (P16-home-glyphs-1440.png): three projects now draw three different marks from their own words, and the sidebar, rail, home cards, transcript, composer header and top bar all use them
